story:
AGC Concrete is a Southwest Michigan-based concrete services provider and one of the top concrete construction companies in the region. With a highly trained team of expert contractors, we specialize in residential and commercial concrete work, including driveways, patios, walkways, stamped concrete, garage floors, foundation work, repairs, and decorative finishes.

We use only high-quality materials and deliver reliable craftsmanship to bring your project to life. Every job is backed by our labor and materials workmanship warranty, and we offer flexible financing options to make your next concrete project hassle-free. We specialize in residential, commercial, and industrial concrete — proudly serving Macomb, Clinton Township, and the surrounding Macomb County communities with a 4.9-star rating across 149 Google reviews.
